data.one_liner: Access SIM card details, mobile network info, eSIM status, and multi-SIM info in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin providing access to cellular network operators, country codes, SIM states, device IDs, eSIM support, and multi-SIM information on Android and iOS. It also supports reactive change streams for monitoring SIM insertions, removals, and network switching.
use_when: You need to read SIM card details, operator names, or country codes.
Your app needs to detect multi-SIM setups and look up individual subscription IDs.
You need to listen for live SIM or network roaming changes.
avoid_when: Targeting iOS platforms where phone number, IMEI, ICCID, and roaming are restricted by privacy limits.
You cannot handle native Android permissions like READ_PHONE_STATE.
strengths: Supports both multi-SIM and eSIM information lookup.
Provides reactive stream updates for SIM and network state changes.
Typed network info enums for generation (2G-5G) and type.
weaknesses: iOS has platform-level privacy limitations hiding phone numbers, IMEIs, and ICCIDs.
Requires runtime Android permissions for full phone state access.
data.setup_notes: Android requires adding the READ_PHONE_STATE permission to AndroidManifest.xml and requesting it at runtime. iOS 13.0+ requires the esim-access entitlement for supportsEsim.
